question: In which of the following states is the groundnut fair, 'Kadalekayi Parishe' celebrated on the last Monday of the Karthika month of the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The groundnut fair, known as **'Kadalekayi Parishe'**, is celebrated in the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• The festival takes place on the **last Monday of the Karthika month** of the Hindu calendar.
 
• **Kadalekayi Parishe** is celebrated in the Basavanagudi locality of **Bengaluru**, Karnataka.
 
• This fair marks the offering of the first groundnut harvest to the **Nandi Bull temple**, also known as Basavanagudi Bull temple.
 
• The festival attracts a large number of farmers and vendors from various regions who bring their groundnut harvest for sale.
 
• Basavanagudi is named after the **Basava (Bull)** temple, which is central to the celebrations.
 
• **Traditional rituals**, cultural performances, and various stalls selling groundnuts and other items are a major part of the fair.
 
• The festival is not only a celebration of the harvest but also fosters community bonding and cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kerala**__

 __
 
• **Kerala** is known for its rich cultural festivals such as **Onam**, **Thrissur Pooram**, and **Vishu**, but **Kadalekayi Parishe** is not traditionally celebrated here.
 
• The state is famous for its **lush greenery**, **spices**, and **backwaters**.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 __
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is renowned for festivals like **Pongal**, **Mahamaham**, and **Navaratri**.
 
• The state has a strong tradition of **agricultural and harvest festivals**, but the groundnut fair is not part of its cultural celebrations.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is known for its tribal and cultural festivals like **Bhagoria**, **Lokrang**, and **Khajuraho Dance Festival**.
 
• The groundnut fair is not a traditional festival celebrated in this state.
